snippet.title: JOLLY: Let's Party | Cast Reveal
snippet.description:
"Welcome back to Jolly's Fantasy World!" 

After eight years of decline, Jolly Entertainment decides to reopen and completely rebuild its controversial fast food restaurant, Jolly's Fantasy World, with a new line of animatronics called the Partytronics. These animatronics cost a fortune to produce, along with a large part of the restaurant itself. As a result, they hire a security guard to watch over the place at night to prevent theft until reopening day.

CREDITS:
Boxin - Directing, Editing, Lighting
Aziel5910 - Animation, Rendering
Btchfx - Soundtracks & SFX
elTizo - Enviroments, Models & Texturing

Special thanks to the entire Let's Party team who make the game a reality every day!

VOICE ACTORS: 🎤
Party Jolly: Adam Argam (https://x.com/AdamArgam)
Party Gena: AerelisVA (https://x.com/AerelisVA)
Michelle Murdock: Robin van der Niet (https://x.com/robinvanderniet)
Kevin Johnson: HatMaster777 (https://x.com/HMaster777)

Follow us on our social media to stay tuned for future news! 🐝
